desc:
🏡 Adopt & Care for Your  Own Ai Baby! 👶

👶 Adopt a Baby – Choose a cute baby to adopt and give them a loving home!


🍼 Feed & Care – Keep your baby happy by feeding, bathing, and playing with them.
👍 Chat with your baby! they respond to almost anything!


🏠 Customize Your Home – Choose a home for you and your child! Cook them warm delicous meals!


🎡 Explore & Play – Take your baby on fun adventures, visit parks, and play with them!

💖 Are you ready to become the best parent? Start your journey today! 💖

 This game is in sandbox mode. Expect bugs because of the early stage of development

Genre: Family, Roleplay, Hangout, Baby, Town & City, BabyCare, Daycare, Childcare, Simulator
